purpose: Review official Kaliningrad cadastral-map and municipal geoportal channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel evidence.
assessment: The official city geoportal is reachable and lists Земельные участки, with a public EPSG:3857 project extent. The official municipal spatial-data page also publishes land-parcel-related address-register files. No bounded anonymous parcel feature response with a safe native ID and geometry was obtained.
registryAssessment: registryFound is true because a local official public map channel with a land-parcels layer was evidenced. This does not establish a local cadastral custodian or prove that the layer is downloadable parcel geometry; Rosreestr/NSPD remain the national cadastral references.
